query:
SELECT 
  name,
  JSON_TYPE(olfactiveProfile) as op_type,
  JSON_TYPE(therapeuticProperties) as tp_type,
  LEFT(olfactiveProfile, 80) as op_preview,
  LEFT(therapeuticProperties, 80) as tp_preview
FROM molecules 
WHERE name IN ('Ambroxan', 'Linalol', 'Géosmine', 'Bétuline', 'Acide Benzoïque', 'Vanilline')
LIMIT 6;
